steps.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: premium 3D character modeling reference, full-body orthographic turnaround, sheet 01 of a coherent production reference pack.
Primary request: Make a remarkably high quality, extremely clear 3-view production reference for the existing character 理論の化身 (Theory Incarnation), faithful to the attached character artwork. Render as finely sculpted cinematic dark fantasy 3D with believable separated materials and exceptionally readable forms, not a loose painting.
Input images: Image 1 is the PRIMARY identity/design reference. Image 2 is an older turnaround, useful for silhouette and costume continuity only; improve precision and eliminate its accidentally human side-profile face. These are references, not artwork to collage.
Character invariants: tall slender humanoid spiritual entity, fully concealed by long layered black robes, TWO enormous black feathered wings attached to the upper back; elongated recessed featureless pitch-black oval facial void with NO eyes, nose, mouth, mask ornament or human profile; crown-like dense thin jagged black thorn growth surrounding the head, tallest at the top; high multi-layer pointed weathered silver-black collar and shoulder mantle; black long central tabard printed with fine square Reversi board grid and a sparse pattern of flat round black and pale stone inlays; two distressed silver-gray vertical stole borders; deep broad draping sleeves, long black articulate claw-like hands, five fingers per hand; floor-length layered frayed robe hem conceals feet. Black feather surfaces have charcoal variation and pale edge wear, not shiny solid metal blades. Quiet, intelligent, imposing.
Composition: wide landscape reference plate, ideally 3840x2160 or largest native high-detail output. Exactly 3 full-height views, left FRONT, narrow middle RIGHT SIDE facing left, right BACK. Front and back wings fully extended, side shows same anatomical wing pose foreshortened. Use horizontal space sensibly, side view can be narrower; none of the figures or wings overlap. All character crown tips and robe hem baselines aligned and identical height. Strict orthographic, absolutely straight front and rear, exact 90-degree profile. Both arms in a relaxed low A pose about 25 degrees from body with straight neutral elbows, open hands visible and separated from robe. Wing tips and every robe hem contained with margins. No pedestal. Thin light horizontal alignment guides only behind figures. Background uniformly light neutral gray.
Design continuity: show one and the same model rotated. Collar layers, wing attachment heights, digit count, tabard design, stole widths and cloth length must be consistent. Rear shows layered black cloth between wings and continuation of two gray stole tails, NOT a second chest or a rear face. Head in side view is a smooth recessed black void with a thorn surround and no protruding human nose/lips. Keep cloth fine grid straight in the rest pose and conforming to folds.
Lighting: large soft neutral studio lights, fill light to keep every black surface readable, delicate ambient occlusion, controlled rim highlights, no dramatic darkness or bloom. Rich microtexture, seams, feather overlap, thin cloth thickness and worn silver trim. Greyscale/neutral silver-black only.
Text: only small unobtrusive labels "FRONT", "RIGHT SIDE", "BACK", and "01 / FORM". No Japanese lettering, no long notes, no decorative typography.
Avoid: redesign, extra wings, floating rocks or stones, orbit graphics, smoky background, luminous runes, weapons, jewelry, human face, golden accents, white angel wings, armored knight body, nudity, perspective view, inconsistent proportions, cropped tips, unreadable black masses, busy poster composition, watermark.

steps.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the attached 3D modeling turnaround with EXACTLY TWO anatomical corrections. Retain its whole three-view layout, character design, every robe, grid, stone, wing, trim, feather detail, lighting and image quality.
1. In the MIDDLE side view, remove the nose, lips, chin bulges and all human profile anatomy. This is a NON-HUMAN EMPTY HOOD-LIKE HEAD. The forward edge of the head must be a straight/slightly curved thin thorn-edged opening into empty black space, NOT a human silhouette. The crown is a thorny shell around a recessed void.
2. In the RIGHT rear view, remove the black oval facial opening. This is the BACK of the head, so show a CLOSED densely interwoven dark thorn shell over the rear cranium, with layered branch-like sculpted strands, pale edge highlights and no opening. The void opening exists ONLY at the front.
Do not change the LEFT front view. No redesign, no extra features, no human face, no glow. Preserve generous margins. Produce at highest available native detail.

Use case: precise-object-edit.
Correct ONLY the RIGHTMOST BACK VIEW in the attached 3-view turnaround. The user specifically points out that the wings do not look like they grow out of the back. Fix the anatomy convincingly, at high quality. Preserve the left front and middle side views unchanged.
The right figure must be an unmistakable true rear view of the same winged entity, not a repeated frontal chest with wings attached to the sides of the neck.
CRITICAL WING ATTACHMENT:
- Show TWO separate substantial wing roots emerging directly from the UPPER BACK at the left and right scapula positions, BELOW the back of the neck and MEDIAL to the shoulders. These are additional wing limbs, not arms and not shoulder ornaments.
- A clearly visible narrow central vertical strip of dark back robe/spine separates the two roots.
- Each wing has a robust feather-covered basal segment protruding BACKWARD out through a fitted opening in the rear cloak, then sweeping outward and upward into its enormous feather fan.
- Expose enough of the first wing segment and feathered root to read the junction. The robe cloth wraps around the base of each root with a small clear edge and contact shadow; feather flow radiates naturally from each root through upper-arm and forearm-like wing structure.
- The back camera sees these protruding roots IN FRONT OF the underlying rear torso fabric; the cloth cannot cover the wing roots or make wings float alongside the shoulders.
- REMOVE the chest-shaped silver V ornament currently on the back of the neck. Show a subdued short rear collar above the roots and clear back-facing layered clothing. Keep the established paired gray stole tails below, allowing the wing root openings in the upper back.
- Wings must show their dorsal/back feather surfaces, not a copy-paste of the frontal wings. Maintain original large wing silhouette and span.
- The true back of the hands, elbows, sleeves and thorn-crowned closed rear head face this rear camera; no palms presented like the front view.
Keep the full crown and wing tips in frame; exact same height, palette, materials, overall outfit and studio background. Hands remain separate human-like arms below the wings. Do not add straps, machinery, an exposed human body, extra wings or new decorative objects. Only alter the right rear figure and its correct anatomy. The rear wing roots are the most important feature in the image.

Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit ONLY the RIGHTMOST REAR FIGURE of the attached 3-view character sheet. The user requests a CLOAK WITH A CLOSED BACK. The current rear wrongly looks like an open front robe with two silver lapels and a central opening.
Replace that rear garment design below the neck with ONE BROAD, CONTINUOUS, CLOSED BLACK CAPE covering the whole back from nape to hem. Remove BOTH silver-gray vertical stole/lapel strips from the REAR only. Eliminate the apparent opening, split or exposed inner garment down the middle of the back. The back must be continuous black fabric across the spine and hips, with broad naturally falling folds across it and a subtly tattered solid lower edge. Do not create a center slit at any height. Do not copy front lapels or the front grid tabard onto the back.
Keep the improved two large feathered wing roots protruding from the upper back through two SMALL FITTED LOCAL openings in the cape, one over each scapula. Cloth flows around each root and becomes one uninterrupted broad draping cape below them. The two wing openings are local oval apertures snugly fitted around the bases, NOT vertical slits that run down the back. Maintain clear central cloth bridge between the roots. Back shoulders and hands face away properly; no front-side palms.
Preserve exactly the existing wing shape, span, feather quality, upper-back attachment position, CLOSED thorn-crown rear, short rear collar, overall character height and monochrome palette. Left FRONT and middle SIDE figures must remain unchanged. Same neutral soft lighting and clean background. Only correct the rear clothing construction. The reference contains a full-body back view at the right. This edit must visibly replace the two long pale rear strips with a continuous dark cloth mantle. Highest available native image quality.

Use case: stylized-concept.
Make sheet 02 of a premium cinematic 3D modeling reference pack for Theory Incarnation. Use the attached final turnaround as the strict visual identity reference, but create NEW EXTREME CLOSE-UPS, not another whole-body turnaround. Landscape approximately 3:2, highest available native detail, physically based high quality sculpted 3D surfaces, neutral light-gray studio background. Four large clearly separated panels in a balanced 2x2 grid, simple small labels.
TOP LEFT, label "HEAD / FRONT": close-up front of the entire thorn-crowned head and layered pointed collar to upper chest. Head is an elongated pitch-black EMPTY RECESSED OPENING, surrounded by dense black branching thorns that rise to a tall central crown point. No eyes, nose, lips, skull or hidden human face. Show thickness of the thorn rim, thorn branching, depth of the empty opening, collar layer overlap, weathered blackened-silver edges. Crown tips fully contained.
TOP RIGHT, label "HEAD / SIDE + BACK": two generous isolated close-ups of the same head: exact 90-degree side and exact rear. Side has a nearly straight/slightly curved open front rim, without human facial protrusions. Rear of head is a CLOSED dark interwoven thorn shell with highlight-visible strands, never a rear facial hole. Same thorn language and proportions as top left.
BOTTOM LEFT, label "HAND / PALM + BACK": two large full views of the SAME right hand from palm and back, with sleeve cuffs. Five slender non-human articulated fingers (one thumb, four fingers) with slightly tapered black tips, lightly spread to show individual joints. Black stone-like/leathery surface and small overlapping hard ridges at knuckles. Match the existing hands, no bare human skin. Palms and dorsal views must be anatomically reciprocal. Modelable solid structures; do not fuse digits.
BOTTOM RIGHT, label "COLLAR / TABARD": tightly cropped three-quarter shoulder/collar/upper-chest construction detail showing stacked curved blackened-silver collar fins over a short feather mantle, distressed gray stole edging framing a black cloth tabard with a clean square grid and a few low relief round black and pale Reversi disc inlays. Show the difference between worn metal, matte woven cloth, and smooth stone. Grid follows fabric, no buttons or chains substituted for stone discs.
Consistent broad soft studio key and fill lighting across all panels; keep charcoal surfaces richly visible, crisp meaningful modeled macro forms before micro scratches. Intricate but plausible craft, subtle wear, no noisy pseudo-detail. No wings in this close-up sheet, no effects, no floating stones, no logos, no added colorful accessories, no ornamental text. Only the four specified small English labels and tiny "02 / DETAILS".

Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset: sheet 03, wing attachment and costume construction reference for a high quality 3D model of the EXISTING character in the attached turnaround. Create NEW large close-ups and construction studies, not another whole-body turnaround. Preserve the final character design and black/silver materials. This is a modeling interpretation of hidden construction, not a new character.
Highest available native resolution, 3:2 landscape, beautiful precise cinematic 3D sculpt rendering with soft bright studio lighting and light neutral-gray background. Four clearly separated panels in a 2x2 layout.
TOP LEFT "UPPER BACK / ATTACHMENT": large rear three-quarter close-up from head to waist. This is the most important panel. Angle the camera approximately 35 degrees around the back so we clearly see the DEPTH of two powerful additional wing limbs emerging BACKWARD from the LEFT AND RIGHT SHOULDER BLADES of the torso. The normal arms and shoulders remain separately visible in their sleeves lower and farther lateral. Each feathered wing base protrudes posteriorly from a fitted opening in the back robe, then bends outward/upward. Show only proximal wing halves in this closeup to devote resolution to the connection. Leave a narrow vertical central strip of back cloth clearly visible between the two root joints. Curved robe opening rims hug roots, with contact shadows and cloth seams, showing they are connected to the torso rather than floating or sewn to shoulder armor. Wings overlap in front of the back fabric in this rear view. The rear thorn head is CLOSED woven thorns, with no rear face. Back collar is a simple subdued short dark collar. The back is ONE CONTINUOUS CLOSED BLACK CAPE from nape to hem, with two small fitted local wing openings only. Absolutely NO silver vertical stole borders, front lapels, center slit or central opening on the back. The gray stole borders exist only on the front.
TOP RIGHT "ROOT / SIDE SECTION": large simplified side cutaway diagram rendered as charcoal clay, of clothed upper torso with the root of ONE wing clearly protruding behind the scapula, separate from the normal arm/shoulder. Ghost the outer robe ONLY in this panel to show a smooth abstract torso volume and three linked solid wing segments: torso socket, basal segment, outward wing elbow. Small unobtrusive arrows mark rotation directions. Do not show real human skin, organs or gore, just a clean nonhuman mannequin-like construction study. This is one integrated wing limb, not a mechanical attachment. No machine parts, straps or riveted harness.
BOTTOM LEFT "WING / FEATHER LAYERS": one isolated entire black feathered wing from root to tip, its dorsal surface shown at a slight oblique angle so we see thickness; dense small coverts on root, medium overlapping secondaries and long swept primary feathers toward tip. Beside it three individual representative feathers at larger scale with clear quill and vane texture. Match the reference wing silhouette. No metallic sword feathers.
BOTTOM RIGHT "ROBE / LAYERS": close-up three-quarter section of lower costume hem, with ONLY a small corner gently separated into visible overlapping layers: inner matte black fabric, structured dark grid tabard bearing shallow round Reversi disc inlays, distressed gray woven FRONT stole strip, continuous ragged-edged outer black cape. Include a small closed-back cape silhouette swatch confirming no center opening. Show sewn edge thickness, soft fabric folds, wear concentrated at edges; no coat made entirely of solid feathers or metal. Tiny separated finish samples can illustrate black cloth, worn silver trim, dark feather.
Keep enough quiet space between panels. Extremely readable real construction and material differentiation. Palette strictly black, charcoal, weathered silver and ivory stone accents. No ethereal smoke, glow, orbiting props, environmental background, posed human face, weapons, text paragraphs or invented dimensions. Only the four short specified English panel labels and "03 / CONSTRUCTION".

Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset: final appearance reference, image 04 of the existing Theory Incarnation character modeled in the attached turnaround. Create a brand-new incredibly detailed high-end cinematic 3D character render faithfully matching this exact design. ONE COMPLETE CHARACTER ONLY, at a gentle front three-quarter angle, without other inset figures or panels. Highest available native resolution, approximately square canvas to contain the full open wings.
Tall inhuman empty-faced thorn-crowned black winged scholar/divinity. No human face: featureless deep black recessed oval opening inside thorn shell, NO nose, eyes or mouth. Thorny branching crown tallest at center. Tall stacked blade-like curved weathered blackened-silver collar plates, shoulder feather mantle. Enormous two black birdlike feathered wings visibly attached to the upper back behind the collar/shoulders, not floating beside the head. Lower arms and wings are separate appendages. Closed black cloak across the entire BACK, no center rear slit and no rear silver stole strips. Front opening has the original two distressed gray/silver stole borders and central black tabard with fine square Reversi board grid and sparse low-relief smooth pale/black round stone inlays. Wide sleeves, long fine black claw-like five-finger hands, open calm commanding gesture. Floor-length soft layered ragged cloak hem with no feet showing.
Look: collector-quality 3D maquette / premium film character asset, highly disciplined primary shapes and exquisite fine sculpt detail, high fidelity physically based rendering. FEATHERS are dark keratin with fine barbs and silky subtle directional sheen; not uniform metallic swords. CLOTH is tactile heavy black woven fabric in broad deep folds, distressed overlapping ragged edging, the back hangs as a continuous cape. SILVER TRIM is patinated dark metal with brushed edge wear; DISCS are smooth dark stone and pale porcelain, clearly flatter than spheres. Face cavity stays completely black while outer thorn geometry is crisply readable. Neutral charcoal, silver and tiny ivory highlights only.
Camera: lens with low perspective distortion, eye level or slightly below upper torso, full-body centered, wide wings completely within generous side margins, crown and all hem in frame. Relaxed dignified stance, no action blur or wind storm. Pale warm-gray seamless studio background, soft contact shadow under robe, no pedestal. Beautiful broad neutral key light from upper left, strong enough soft fill on dark side to read construction, restrained cool rim light. High dynamic range but no bloom, volumetric smoke, particles, fog, noisy backdrop or crushed blacks. No surrounding floating stones, orbit graphics, cards, throne, wings on shoulders instead of back, extra props, logos, labels or text. This is a useful clean modeling/material reference, not an atmospheric poster.
